[2026-08-30T08:05:38.001Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-08-30T08:05:38.001Z] [arbiter] The traders were right. Aetherkin. Some kneel to them; some burn them where they stand.
[2026-08-30T08:05:38.001Z] [world] In life it was a ward-sister of some drowned infirmary, a splint still lashed to their own arm — they could be anyone's — a neighbour, a stranger, the person you'd have been. They surfaced out of the flat mud like a held breath finally, ter
ribly let go.
[2026-08-30T08:05:38.002Z] [world] It flinches from you and puts its back to the wall, hands raised — not a hunter, just something frightened that has forgotten everything except how to be afraid.
[2026-08-30T08:05:38.002Z] [world] You push east. The silt is heavy underfoot, the horizon unchanged.
[2026-08-30T08:05:38.002Z] [world] What you started here has not finished itself in your absence.
